release_scope: delivery-mode correction and Antigravity IDE user-goal templates

antigravity_goal_templates.scope: user-facing /goal templates only; core Skill remains host-agnostic

changes: Default long-output mode is automatic file batching.
Interactive mode is explicit option 2 and submits at most one complete Segment per turn.
Antigravity IDE workspace, file, tool-loop, and pause rules are confined to user templates.
Ref2VA minimum detail and partial-cursor safeguards remain enabled.
known_limits: Autonomous file batching depends on Antigravity IDE tool availability, workspace permissions, disk capacity, context budget, and runtime limits.
A completed prompt package does not mean images, video, or audio were generated or artistically approved.
